integrity: The sharp global claims have analytical proofs conditional on the cited outer-extremal theorem. Exact-rational checks and random stress tests are supplementary and do not constitute an independent audit.
scientific_limitations: The exact threshold t_* and the support functional beyond the binomial regime are not determined. Existence of a separated coexistence threshold and strict rational bounds are proved; an earlier equivalent result outside the inspected literature cannot be excluded.
title: A discontinuous third-coefficient extremizer transition in \(H^{1/2}\)
